description.p: Attune is a native GTK4/libadwaita settings app for Hyprland, forked from HyprMod by Ivo Šmerek. Preview appearance, display, and motion changes through compositor IPC, then review an exact diff before saving dedicated Lua overrides. Hand-authored bindings, startup behavior, and rules stay outside the editor.

ul.li: Live preview of supported visual settings
Monitor configuration with layout preview; VRR, HDR, and 10-bit detection
Bezier curve editor with draggable control points and live animation preview
Pending Changes with an explicit reviewed-save action
Dotfiles-safe saves with symlink preservation and previous-output backups
Search supported visual options with Ctrl+F
Undo with Ctrl+Z

description.p: Plugins page, multi-action window rules, and a round of keybind and Lua fixes:

ul.li: Plugins page for configuring Hyprland plugins, starting with Hypr Dynamic Cursors
Window rules can carry several actions, and all of them now apply and save in Lua mode
The Run command keybind action can pick from installed apps
Recording media keys, AltGr keys, or keys on a secondary layout produces binds Hyprland accepts
Described Lua keybinds show their real action, and binds HyprMod cannot edit safely are read-only
The Norwegian keyboard layout saves and applies correctly in Lua mode
A Lua config that prints no longer breaks startup, and an unreadable one shows what went wrong
Rotated monitors can be set back to Normal in Lua mode

description.p: New input options, command-line profiles, and Lua migration fixes:

ul.li: Command-line profile switching: hyprmod profile apply/next/previous/list for keybinds and scripts
Multiple keyboard layouts: add, reorder, and edit input sources (layout plus variant)
Gestures page hides itself when there's no touchpad or touchscreen to drive it
Lua migration fixes for keybind modifiers, the global dispatcher, and workspace layoutopt rules
Monitor fixes: disabled outputs stay listed, re-enabling no longer overlaps or crashes the page
Refresh monitors no longer discards unsaved changes

description.p: Lua config support, new pages, and major fixes:

ul.li: Lua config support: read and edit hyprland.lua directly, with a "Migrate to Lua" wizard (Hyprland 0.55+)
Per-monitor "Identify by description" toggle for port-independent monitor configs
Advanced HDR controls: Color Management presets, SDR brightness/saturation, luminance sliders
Workspaces page: manage workspace rules with live preview and live IPC apply
Deprecation assistant: detect and migrate deprecated syntax with user confirmation and backups
Convenience installer (install.sh) and --install / --uninstall CLI flags
In-app bug reporting with prefilled GitHub issues
Per-monitor VRR control with "Use global" and corrected Off behavior
Named window and layer rules support

description.p: New configuration pages and UX improvements:

ul.li: Window Rules page — manage windowrule entries with a window picker and live preview
Layer Rules page — manage layerrule entries with curated presets and live preview
Autostart page — manage exec and exec-once entries with an app picker
Env Variables page — manage env entries with POSIX name validation
Pending Changes page — review every unsaved edit across the app in one place
Mouse-drag (bindm) keybinds with dispatcher, category, and preset support
Sidebar reorganized by task; Dwindle, Master, and Scrolling merged into a single Layouts page
Profiles page redesigned — active profile promoted to a hero card with the saved-profiles list below; cards show last-modified date
Saving keeps the active profile in sync automatically
